name: Luis Renan Pavanello
summary: Full Stack Developer and Independent Technology Consultant with 9+ years of experience building scalable web products across education, fintech, and software. I specialize in backend architecture, database optimization, API integrations, and maintainable full-stack delivery using PHP/Laravel, Python/Django, and modern JavaScript stacks including React, Node.js, and TypeScript. Alongside product development, I have provided remote technology consulting for international clients and contributed to specialized AI evaluation and training engagements for LinkedIn/AnyoneAI. This work included creating high-quality benchmark datasets, detailed annotations, and real-world developer workflows to help improve coding agents and code-editing models. I enjoy turning complex requirements into reliable products through technical rigor, pragmatic problem- solving, and agile collaboration. Fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish, I am open to opportunities involving backend systems, full-stack development, fintech, developer tools, and AI-enabled products. Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, I’m always eager to connect with like-minded professionals and explore opportunities to innovate and grow. Let’s build something amazing together!
